words.trans: v.（及物）①搭、支（帐篷）；②投掷；③推销、定音调；pitch the tent 搭帐篷
examples: They pitched the tent on a flat strip of ground.

words.trans: adj.（地面）沼泽般的、泥泞湿软的
examples: The moor was soft and boggy underfoot.

words.trans: n. 莎草、薹草（水边丛生草本植物）
examples: Sedge grew thick along the edge of the pool.

words.trans: n.（河堤、土堤）填土筑出来的堤岸
examples: They climbed up the earthen embankment of the reservoir.

words.trans: n.（地理义）沙嘴、狭长陆岬（向水里伸出去的狭长陆地）
examples: A narrow spit of land reached out into the lake.

words.trans: （水流）注入、流入（水体）
examples: The small river empties into the reservoir below.

words.trans: v. 飞速移动、滚滚而来（像木桶翻滚那样气势汹汹冲过来）；n. 木桶、桶
examples: The van barrelled down the empty country lane.

words.trans: ①字面（狗/野兽）靠嗅觉找出某物（本文 Archie 是狗狗，用鼻子嗅探发现东西）；②引申（人）察觉、打探出、发掘秘密（The reporter sniffed out a scandal. 记者打探出一桩丑闻）
examples: Archie sniffed out the scent of the missing bag.

words.trans: adv. 得意洋洋地，带着发现猎物般的欣喜，胜利地
examples: 'Found it!' the dog barked triumphantly.

words.trans: n. 软骨
examples: The vet examined the torn cartilage in the knee.

words.trans: n.（船、飞机、无人机的）方向舵
examples: The wind jammed the drone's rudder for a moment.

words.trans: 确切地说、准确来讲
examples: It was cold — freezing, to be precise.

words.trans: 毫无疑问……（there’s no doubt + that 从句）
examples: There's no doubt that they came this way.

words.trans: 合上帐篷（拉上拉链之类）
examples: She closed up the tent and zipped it tight.

words.trans: n. 针叶树、松柏类树木（松树、冷杉、云杉这类结球果 cone 的树）
examples: Tall conifers lined the track in dark ranks.

words.trans: 脑袋被细树枝剐蹭、刮到
examples: Low branches scratched their heads as they passed.

words.trans: n. 手可以抓牢的岩凹/岩凸起（手支点）
examples: He found a firm handhold in the rock face.

words.trans: n. 脚踩的岩点（脚支点）
examples: She searched for a foothold on the wet stone.

words.trans: = handhold + foothold，手脚的攀爬支点
examples: The climber tested the hand-and-foot holds before pulling up.

words.trans: n. 大圆石、巨砾、大块岩石
examples: A huge boulder blocked the narrow path.

words.trans: n. 岩石缝隙、裂口
examples: Snow had gathered deep in every crevice.

words.trans: n.（山丘、悬崖的）顶部、脊线、顶峰
examples: They reached the crest of the ridge at last.

words.trans: n. 大陡崖、峭壁、断崖（地质用词，一边近乎垂直下落的长崖壁）
examples: The long escarpment fell away almost straight down.

words.trans: n. 峡谷、深谷
examples: Below them the river ran deep in a rocky gorge.

words.trans: 松散碎石堆
examples: Her boots sent loose scree rattling down the slope.

words.trans: 降到最低点、到达谷底；也可作经济用语触底
examples: Prices finally bottomed out and started to climb.

words.trans: 到处点缀着、星星点点布满
examples: The hillside was studded with pale boulders.

words.trans: 半隐半现（half-lost in mist 雾中半隐半现）。half- 构词：half-buried 半埋的、half-forgotten 半淡忘的、half-asleep 半睡半醒
examples: The ruined wall lay half-lost in the fern.

words.trans: 英国北方方言，指小山溪
examples: A cold beck ran noisily over the stones.

words.trans: adj. 微不足道的、不起眼的
examples: It looked like an insignificant little stream.

words.trans: adj. 布满车辙的，被车轮轧出一道道凹痕
examples: The rutted cart track was thick with mud.

words.trans: adj.（建筑群）错落蔓延、散漫铺开的，没有规整布局
examples: A rambling old farmhouse sprawled up the hill.

words.trans: adj.（建筑物）矮墩墩的、低矮宽厚、楼层不高；squat and grey 房屋低矮、色调灰暗
examples: The squat grey buildings huddled behind the fence.

words.trans: n. 刀片刺绳、带利刃的刺丝围栏
examples: The yard was ringed by razor-wire fences.

words.trans: n.（复数 perimeters）数学本义为周长（图形外围总长度）；本文语境指外围边界、四周防线
examples: Armed guards patrolled the whole perimeter.

words.trans: 渡鸦。相比 crow 体型更大更壮、喙粗厚弯曲，飞行时尾巴呈楔形(V 形)，叫声低沉浑厚，野外荒山多见、常成对活动、城市少见；西方文学氛围感强，常关联神秘暗黑气氛
examples: A great raven circled above the crags.

words.trans: n. 鵟（kuáng），英国普通鵟，一种大型猛禽，类似老鹰
examples: A buzzard soared high on the rising air.

words.trans: v.（猛禽）鸣叫、嘶鸣。mew 最熟含义是猫咪喵喵叫，但鸟类词典里也专指鵟这类猛禽的悠长啸叫，不是猫叫
examples: The buzzard meweed high overhead.

words.trans: n. 一丛、一簇；a tuft of grass 一小丛草
examples: A tuft of grass clung to the rock face.

words.trans: n. 毛毛细雨、蒙蒙小雨；fine drizzle 细密的小雨
examples: A fine drizzle began to fall.

words.trans: 一缕缕薄云
examples: Thin wisps of cloud trailed across the peak.

words.trans: vi. 挤成一团、蜷缩靠拢，很多人/动物挨紧身体，一般为取暖也可出于害怕
examples: The sheep huddled together against the wind.

words.trans: v. 详细阐述、细说、进一步展开说明
examples: He declined to elaborate on his earlier remarks.

words.trans: v. 翻越、攀爬越过（围墙、栅栏），手脚用力攀越障碍物从顶上翻过去（scale the fence 翻过栅栏、scale the wall 翻墙、scale a mountain 攀登大山）
examples: They scaled the high wire fence to get inside.

words.trans: 行，那你去吧！（另注：Johnny English 憨豆特工）
examples: 'Off you go, then,' she said, waving them away.

words.trans: get … past … 带着某人顺利通过、绕过（守卫），不是简单字面“走过去”；past 介词指越过这道障碍关卡（guards 守卫是一道关卡）
examples: The plan was to get them all past the guards unseen.

words.trans: adj. 惊慌失措的、万分恐慌的
examples: Panic-stricken animals fled in every direction.

words.trans: adj. 沙哑粗嘎的
examples: His hoarse voice cracked as he shouted.

words.trans: 一阵阵迸发出来的声响，断续爆发的噪音。bursts of + 名词固定搭配（bursts of wind 一阵阵狂风、bursts of laughter 一阵阵笑声）
examples: The machine went in short bursts of sound.

words.trans: n. 流苏、外围边缘
examples: They waited at the fringe of the crowd.

words.trans: 固定习语，赶紧逃跑、奋力冲出去逃命
examples: When the gate opened they made a run for it.

words.trans: v. 强光使人目眩、晃得睁不开眼睛
examples: The headlights dazzled them as they crossed.

words.trans: v. 车辆猛拐、侧滑，车身扭向一边
examples: The bike slew sideways across the wet gravel.

words.trans: 一大堆、许许多多
examples: A whole slew of problems appeared all at once.

words.trans: skidded to a stop 最后刹车瞬间打滑停下来
examples: The van skidded to a stop beside them.

words.trans: 把某人包围起来、困住，使之无处脱身
examples: The police hemmed the fugitives in against the wall.

words.trans: （摩托车）尾气（废气，刺鼻）
examples: The air stank of petrol and exhaust fumes.
